ne619e5f061.headline: Prices of iron and cement today Sunday 7-3-2021 in Egypt
ne619e5f061.summary: Prices for iron and cement in Egypt remained stable during transactions on March 7, 2021, with iron priced between 13,300 and 13,700 Egyptian pounds per ton.
ne619e5f061.why: Construction material prices impact infrastructure development and inflation in Egypt's economy.
